claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament has a total purse of $22.5 million.
Rory McIlroy is the winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Rory McIlroy receives $4.5 million from the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The 2026 Masters Tournament winner's payout represents 20% of the total prize pool.
The runner-up of the 2026 Masters Tournament earns $2.43 million.
Scottie Scheffler is the runner-up of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Third place in the 2026 Masters Tournament receives $1.08 million–$1.53 million (split).
All top 12 finishers in the 2026 Masters Tournament earn at least $427,500–$517,500.
Rory McIlroy received $4.2 million as the winner of the 2025 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler received $3.6 million as the winner of the 2024 Masters Tournament.
Jon Rahm received $3.24 million as the winner of the 2023 Masters Tournament.
Scottie Scheffler received $2.7 million as the winner of the 2022 Masters Tournament.
The 2026 Masters Tournament purse increased by $1.5 million from the 2025 tournament.
The Masters Tournament is played annually at Augusta National Golf Club in Georgia.
